assets.purpose: AWS learning roadmap.
assets.alt_text: The roadmap progresses from cloud/account foundations through identity, networking, compute, storage, application platforms, operations, automation, data/AI, and architecture specializations.
assets.caption: Start with foundations; specialize only after the shared core.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: AWS global infrastructure.
assets.alt_text: A simplified hierarchy relates Regions, Availability Zones, and workloads while highlighting account and data-residency decisions.
assets.caption: A Region is a geographic area; Availability Zones are separate fault-isolation locations within it.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: IAM permission evaluation.
assets.alt_text: Authorization depends on identity and resource policies, applicable boundaries/organization controls, conditions, and explicit denies.
assets.caption: Default deny applies; an applicable explicit deny overrides an allow.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: VPC reachability map.
assets.alt_text: Reachability combines subnet routing, a route target, addressability, security groups, network ACLs and service-specific controls.
assets.caption: A route alone does not prove reachability; all relevant network and identity controls matter.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: S3 object protection lifecycle.
assets.alt_text: Objects can be uploaded, protected by access controls and encryption, versioned, transitioned using lifecycle rules, and restored or expired by policy.
assets.caption: Test lifecycle rules on synthetic objects and retain data only as long as required.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Serverless event processing.
assets.alt_text: An event is validated, routed to a function or worker, persisted or acknowledged, and observed; retries and dead-letter handling cover failures.
assets.caption: Assume messages can be delivered more than once; design idempotent consumers.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Cloud operations feedback loop.
assets.alt_text: Metrics, logs, traces and audit events inform alarms, incident response, remediation, and follow-up reliability work.
assets.caption: Choose signals tied to user-visible outcomes and actionable thresholds.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Six Well-Architected pillars.
assets.alt_text: A balanced architecture review considers operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.
assets.caption: Use the six pillars to identify trade-offs and prioritize evidence-based improvements.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork.
